summary: End-to-end tested the new PRIVATE SESSIONS feature (backend + UI). All backend endpoints (request, /mine, admin list, admin PATCH, admin schedule, notifications) pass 9/9 pytest cases. Frontend flow works: homepage banner + CTA (data-testid home-private-sessions & home-private-cta), coming-soon strip contains only Challenges (no Private sessions / Teacher training), /private-sessions page renders €120, 1/2/3 selector updates total correctly, focus/preferred/notes fields work, Continue creates a pending request and advances to the pay step which renders PaymentButtons. Admin Private Sessions tab (admin-tab-private) shows paid requests, adjust + Save + Schedule + Zoom all work, mock Zoom join link is created, student sees the scheduled session with 'Join Zoom' link on /private-sessions, and the notification feed (GET /api/notifications) includes 'Your private session is scheduled'.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduling.py admin_schedule_private: if zoom.create_meeting_for_instance ever returns None (Zoom configured but API errors and mock disabled), session dict would still be pushed with None join_url. Consider guarding meeting is not None before proceeding.

notifications feed can generate duplicate 'Your private session is scheduled' entries when the same request is scheduled multiple times; UI shows both — expected behavior but consider grouping by session_id.
PrivateSessions.jsx: form.focus_area/notes/preferred_time are not length-limited client-side; backend already caps to 500/1000/120 chars which is fine.
admin_schedule_private returns the request doc via find_one but does not $pull the ObjectId; response goes through {_id:0} projection — OK.

PrivateSessionsPane uses <input type='datetime-local'> which is the browser default picker (per code-review guideline noting shadcn calendar preference — but datetime-local is admin-only and acceptable here).
